comparison.objective: Load a press die and operate a two-hand safety control versus mechanically commission a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Blank placement followed by simultaneous separated button pressing versus small-tool alignment, counterholding, fine rotary adjustment, locking, and inspection.
comparison.success_condition: Blank loaded, hands withdrawn, both buttons held until closure versus two safe physical impact cycles after relocking.
comparison.reason: Physical control actuation is only a minor shared primitive; the candidate's core calibration and retention abilities are absent. The record omits numeric die-placement and button-synchronization thresholds.
